name: LazySusanMenu
job: Present dishes or products on a turntable viewed from above that rotates the chosen item to the front with its label and price
visitor_action: drag or swipe to spin; tap an item to bring it forward; arrows rotate step by step
mobile: smaller table, swipe to spin, label under the plate
motion: inertial spin with eased snap to nearest item; the stone's fine grain and hairline graduation ring turn under a fixed soft light; plates counter-rotate to stay upright while their shadows follow the light; reduced-motion: step change with no spin
art_direction: Top-down dark stone turntable with a thin edge highlight, hairline graduation ring and quiet matte hub on a deep neutral ground; clean ivory plates with soft shadows cast from one light; frosted dark caption card in DM Serif Display with champagne price
